# Project Instructions

- Sanity is no longer used in this project.
- Do not add, restore, configure, or recommend Sanity Studio, Sanity schemas, Sanity clients, Sanity queries, or Sanity dependencies.
- Do not direct the user to `/studio` or describe Sanity as the content workflow.
- For project content changes, treat `src/app/dataSets/dataSets.ts` as the source of truth unless the user explicitly identifies a different source.
- Leave existing Sanity files untouched unless the user explicitly asks to remove or migrate them.
